categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies ZMQ notification interface initialization under src/zmq/.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent failure of ZMQ notifications by failing startup on initialization error instead of burying the failure in debug logs. Issue #33715 showed that port collisions were swallowed in debug logs while bitcoind kept running without notifications enabled.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Excluded by definition: a logging or error propagation change whose point is one area's behavior belongs to that area (ZMQ), not utils.
categories.rationale: The edit to src/init.cpp simply consumes the ZMQ initialization result.
